create.name: Francie La Flow
create.bio:
Francie La Flow is a yoga teacher, singer and voice guide who has lived mostly in Ubud, Bali, for about sixteen years, with Koh Phangan in Thailand as her second home. She studied psychology at McGill University, holds 500-hour Yoga Alliance registration, and spent eight years running the Pure Flow yoga school, leading more than two hundred retreats and trainings. A long spell in 2016 when she could not speak at all sent her looking at how feeling, the body and the voice meet, and that question now shapes everything she teaches.

Her approach, which she calls the Vocal Flow Method, brings together mantra and kirtan, simple vocal warm-ups, body-based inquiry, asana and breath, and the psychology of flow. Students do not need any singing experience; the aim is to feel at ease being heard rather than to perform. She leads weekly vocal activation and bhakti yoga classes at The Yoga Barn, sings and teaches at the BaliSpirit Festival, offers one-to-one sessions online and in Ubud, hosts private retreats in Bali and Thailand, and trains facilitators to lead voice circles of their own. She also writes devotional songs, has made an oracle deck and a songbook, and records chants and yoga nidra.

courses.title: Resonance Sessions (1:1 voice and somatic sessions)
courses.description: One-to-one sessions lasting as long as 75 minutes, held in Ubud or over video, mixing breath, sound, gentle movement, mantra and guided inquiry. Each ends with a practice to keep using at home, and there are four-session and monthly options.

courses.title: Rising Resonance
courses.description: A six-session online voice journey that starts with the body and breath before asking anything of the voice. It runs as a private path you can begin at any time or as a smaller group, and no singing background is needed.
courses.price: $1,497 USD private (or 3 × $499); group $497 USD early bird

courses.title: Vocal Flow Facilitator Training
courses.description: A five-day, 50-hour in-person training at The Yoga Barn in Ubud for yoga teachers, musicians and others who want to lead song and voice circles. It covers warm-ups, heart songs, sequencing a circle and holding a group, and is YACEP eligible.

courses.title: Private Retreats in Bali and Thailand
courses.description: Three, five or seven-day retreats planned around one guest, either in a villa in Ubud or by the sea on Koh Phangan. Days combine yoga, voice work, bhakti practice and rest, on dates you choose.

courses.title: inFlow Mentorship
courses.description: A six-month private mentorship, taken on by application after a free conversation. It is shaped around the person's own life and goals, with Francie working alongside them over the whole period.

courses.title: Weekly classes at The Yoga Barn
courses.description: Regular drop-in classes in Ubud, including a Monday vocal activation class of warm-ups, heart songs and mantra, plus bhakti vinyasa and hatha flow sessions. All levels are welcome.

courses.title: Sing Your Heart Open
courses.description: A seven-day recorded practice of short daily rituals using music, movement and voice. Access is lifetime and the practice circle stays open after the week ends.

courses.title: Vocal Flow Library
courses.description: A growing collection of recorded voice classes, warm-ups, mantras and heart songs, with a new session added each month. One payment gives lifetime access.

courses.title: Heard & Held
courses.description: A monthly membership in which you send Francie a voice note each week and she records a personal reply. It suits anyone wanting steady company while they practise using their voice.
courses.price: $33 USD a month or $333 USD a year

courses.title: Sacred Expression Oracle
courses.description: A deck of 42 cards, each paired with a short body and voice ritual, a reflection and a mantra. It comes as a boxed deck or a digital edition, both with an online guidebook.

free_resources.title: Francie La Flow on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free devotional chants and songs, a grounding practice, affirmations, a yoga nidra and an inner silence meditation. Listen at no cost in the app or a browser.

free_resources.title: The Somatic Voice Starter Kit
free_resources.description: Three short guided practices for settling the body and easing back into using your voice. It is emailed to you after you sign up.

free_resources.title: Vocal Flow Circle Blueprint
free_resources.description: A free outline for running one hour-long voice circle, with two warm-ups and a heart song. Written for people thinking of leading circles before committing to the full training.

free_resources.title: Sacred Expression Oracle: free card pull
free_resources.description: Draw one card from her oracle deck online and read its reflection, mantra and suggested body and voice ritual. No purchase is needed.

flags: Her site frames her story around her own trauma and depression and she is a Compassionate Inquiry practitioner (Gabor Maté's trauma method); the products listed are about voice and expression, not conditions, but a human may want to confirm she passes the strict health rule.
The Insight Timer bio could only be saved in part (first sentence) because WebFetch would not quote it in full; bio check run against that plus her site pages.
The retreats page mentions registration with the International Practitioners of Holistic Medicine; left out of the bio.
Rising Resonance price shown as published for both private and group paths; the group runs on Tuesdays in January with early bird to 15 December.
left_out: Heal Your Voice Collection ($497 USD) and its parts Heal Your Voice and Sacred Sounds: Mantra as Medicine: titles use heal/medicine framing, left out as borderline.
Compassionate Inquiry sessions: described as trauma-informed support, left out under the health rule.
Video The Vagus Nerve and Your Voice: How Humming Calms Your Nervous System: physiological framing, left out as borderline.
Videos Women's Health, Healing & Empowerment & the 3V Connection and Tryambakam (Mahamrityunjaya Mantra) · We Pray for Healing: health framing.
Song covers, live festival sing-alongs, short clips and Shorts on her YouTube channel: music-only or under two minutes.
Sound of You workshop (28 October 2026): already passed.
HeartSongs Songbook ($33 USD digital) and Fully Expressed audio journeys: offerings capped at 10.
Flow Consulting: a service for businesses, not teaching.
Free album Wise in Her Ways: music, not a practice.
Insight Timer tracks such as Get Back To Sleep: covered by the profile link only.
